review_comment: The patch adds a filtering rule to exclude the .extensions directory from web deployment, preventing build-time extension files from being exposed to the web-accessible sphere. This addresses a trust boundary violation where sensitive build configuration and extension code could be accessed via web requests. Ensure the filter pattern correctly matches all .extensions subdirectories and files to prevent any leakage.

The change adds .bp-config to the file exclusion patterns during web directory setup, preventing potential exposure of build configuration files. This improves defense-in-depth by ensuring configuration directories are not deployed to web-accessible locations. Maintain consistent exclusion patterns for all sensitive directories to prevent information disclosure.
